record_title: Exact maximum size and structure of q-ary non-overlapping codes of length five
provenance: An exact extremal theorem for q-ary length-five non-overlapping codes, derived from the SQN characterization with a closed-form optimization and equality classification.
limitations: Specific to block length five and dependent on the established SQN characterization. The exceptional q=2,3 maxima are not structurally classified. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older synonymous synchronization terminology.
